mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( CLIENT_KEY VARCHAR2(40) NOT NULL, MO_KEY VARCHAR2(50), MO_NUMBER VARCHAR2(16), SENDER VARCHAR2(16), CALLBACK VARCHAR2(16), RCV_DATE DATE, INS_DATE DATE, PRODUCT VARCHAR2(10), MSG VARCHAR2(4000), TELCO VARCHAR2(10), STATUS VARCHAR2(10), REPLAY_DATE DATE, REPLAY_MSG VARCHAR2(240), SUBJECT VARCHAR2(300), CONTENT_CNT INTEGER, CONTENT_LIST VARCHAR2(1000), CONSTRAINT PK_${tableName} PRIMARY KEY (CLIENT_KEY) )

CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( MO_NUMBER VARCHAR2(16), ALARM_YN VARCHAR2(1) DEFAULT'N', ALARM_DAY_TIME VARCHAR2(20) DEFAULT'09:00~18:00', ALARM_DAY_RECEIVERS VARCHAR2(200), ALARM_DAY_SENDER VARCHAR2(20), ALARM_NIGHT_TIME VARCHAR2(20) DEFAULT'18:00~09:00', ALARM_NIGHT_RECEIVERS VARCHAR2(200), ALARM_NIGHT_SENDER VARCHAR2(20), ALARM_MSG VARCHAR2(240), AUTO_REPLY_YN VARCHAR2(1) DEFAULT'N', AUTO_REPLY_MSG VARCHAR2(240) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} ( CLIENT_KEY, MO_KEY, MO_NUMBER, SENDER, CALLBACK, RCV_DATE, INS_DATE, PRODUCT, MSG, TELCO, STATUS, REPLAY_DATE, REPLAY_MSG, SUBJECT, CONTENT_CNT, CONTENT_LIST ) VALUES ( #{parameter.key}, #{parameter.moKey}, #{parameter.moNumber}, #{parameter.sender}, #{parameter.callback}, TO_DATE(#{parameter.receiveDate}, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), SYSDATE, #{parameter.product}, #{parameter.message}, #{parameter.telco}, #{parameter.status}, TO_DATE(#{parameter.replyDate}, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{parameter.replyMessage}, #{parameter.subject}, #{parameter.contentCount}, #{parameter.contentListString} )
